trans.en: In the Name of Allah, the most Gracious, the most Merciful.
trans.rurdu: (Shuru karta hu) Allah ke naam se Jo bada maher-baan nehaayat rahem karne waala hai.
trans.urdu: اللہ کے نام سے (شروع کرتا ہوں) جو بڑا مہربا ن نہایت رحم کرنے والا ہے۔

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔ اَللّٰهُمَّ اَنْتَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّوْمُ اَلْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيْمُ اَلْخَالِقُ الرَّازِقُ اَلْمُحْيِي الْمُمِيْتُ اَلْبَدِيْءُ الْبَدِيْعُ لَكَ الْكَرَمُ وَلَكَ الْجُوْدُ وَلَكَ الْمَنُّ وَلَكَ الْاَمْرُ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَكَ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAAHUMMA SALLE A’LAA MOHAMMADIW WA AALE MOHAMMADIN. ALLAAHUMMA ANTAL HAIYYUL QAIYYOO-MO AL-A’LIYYUL A’ZEEMO AL-KHAALE-QUR RAAZE-QO, AL-MOH-YIL MOMEE-TO. AL-BADEE-O’ LAKAL KARAMA WA LAKAL JOO-DO WA LAKAL MANNO WA LAKAL AMRO WAHDA-KA LAA SHAREE-KA LAKA.

trans.en: O Allah bless Muhammad and his family O Allah You are the Ever Living, the Eternal the Elevated, the Mighty the Creator, the Sustainer the One who gives life and the One who causes to die the Beginner, the Unique For You is nobility and for You is generosity and for You is grace and for You is the command You are One there is no partner for You.
trans.urdu: انشاء اللہ ترجمہ جلد آرہا ہے

arabic.text: يَا خَالِقُ يَا رَازِقُ يَا مُحْيِيْ يَا مُمِيْتُ يَا بَدِيْعُ يَا رَفِيْعُ اَسْئَلُكَ اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَاَنْ تَرْحَمَ ذُلِّ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ وَتَضَرُّعِيْ اِلَيْكَ وَحْشَتِيْ مِنَ النَّاسِ وَاُنْسِيْ بِك۔

lines.rarabic: YAA KHAALE-QO YAA RAAZE-QO YAA MOH-YEE YAA MOMEE-TO YAA BADEE-O’ YAA RAFEE-O’ AS-ALOKA AN TO-SALLE-YA A’LAA MOHAMMADIW WA AALE MOHAMMADIN WA AN TAR-HAMA ZULLE BAIYNA YA-DAIY-KA WA TA-ZARRO-EE’ ILAIKA WAH-SHA-TEE MINAN NAASE WA OON-SEE-BEKA.

trans.en: O Creator, O Sustainer O the One who gives life and the One who causes to die O the Unique, the Sublime. I ask you to bless Muhammad and his family and to have mercy on my lowliness before You and my beseeching You and my loneliness from people and my intimacy with You.

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAHUMMA SWALLE ALAA MUHAMMADIW WA AALE MUHAMMADIN

trans.en: Allah’s (s.w.t) choicest blessings be upon Mohammed and his holy progeny.
trans.rurdu: Parwardigaar Tu rehmat naazil farma Hazrat Muhammad (s.a.w.a) aur unki Aal (a.s) par.
trans.urdu: اے معبود! رحمت نازل فرما حضرت محمدؐ اور انکی آل ؑپر۔
